basic_info.description: Welcome to 125 Highland Avenue, where your San Francisco adventure begins! This stylish 3-bedroom condominium in Bernal Heights offers the perfect blend of charm, convenience, and modern updates all in one of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods. Step into your new home and be greeted by stunning period details like 10-foot ceilings, dramatic columns, picture moldings and refinished parquet floors that give the space character and warmth. The sunlit living room, with its large south-facing windows, is your cozy retreat, while the updated eat-in kitchen (2024) features sleek quartz countertops and brand-new stainless steel appliances perfect for hosting friends or whipping up your favorite meals. Two stylish bedrooms offer comfort, and the third doubles as a home office, making it easy to balance work and play. With secure one-car parking, a 91 Walk Score, and a location just a block from Holly Park, boutique shops, and buzzing cafes along the Cortland corridor and Mission Street, this home puts the best of the city right at your doorstep. Plus, you're minutes from freeway access, making weekend escapes effortless. Why wait? Make this your home and the launchpad for your city-living adventure!
